items.title: Loren M. "Tex" Brewster Interview, 1984-06-25
items.q: Did you know a violin player named Garner? No we didn't have anybody except Joe Vanuti.

ctx.x: well Jack Jack did repeat himself a lot I thought I thought his solos were wonderful but he did repeat himself yeah same one night after night he played dinner but the outfit that made the thing it was Red Nichols and Miff Mole and Jimmy who was that darn piano player he married that Negro girl what is it? well it sounds like you're talking about New York piano players yeah there were a lot of them there was uh Frank Signorelli uh what I know him uh what's the name of these gunners? Leighton? Leighton? Leighton?…

brass bass with uh you know the tuba with uh gold cat I don't remember if we had one or not or string bass yeah Steve Brown I think we talked about I mentioned him to you and that name didn't you didn't remember Steve I don't believe I remember that name do you remember any of these tunes in the evening and evening yeah I know that one and where the lazy daisies grow where the lazy daisies grow that was the first two tunes we recorded I see and uh my sweetheart I don't remember that one by name I probably know…
